props.name: namespace

namespaces).

state

props.name: target_size_mb

props.name: snapshot_expiration
max_snapshot_age
props.description: Updates the maximum age for snapshots optionally.

props.name: min_snapshots_to_keep
props.description: Updates the minimum number of snapshots to retain optionally.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Returns a list of tables in the specified namespace within an R2 catalog.
methods.description:
Returns a list of tables in the specified namespace within an R2 catalog.
Supports pagination for efficient traversal of large table collections.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Use this to identify the account.

props.name: bucket_name
props.description: Specifies the R2 bucket name.

props.name: page_size
props.description:
Maximum number of tables to return per page. Defaults to 100,
maximum 1000.

props.name: page_token
props.description:
Opaque pagination token from a previous response. Use this to fetch
the next page of results.

props.name: return_details
props.description:
Whether to include additional metadata (timestamps, locations).
When true, response includes created_at, updated_at, metadata_locations, and
locations arrays.

props.name: return_uuids
props.description:
Whether to include table UUIDs in the response. Set to true to
receive the table_uuids array.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Returns a list of namespaces in the specified R2 catalog.
methods.description:
Returns a list of namespaces in the specified R2 catalog. Supports hierarchical
filtering and pagination for efficient traversal of large namespace hierarchies.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Use this to identify the account.

props.name: page_size
props.description:
Maximum number of namespaces to return per page. Defaults to 100,
maximum 1000.

props.name: page_token
props.description:
Opaque pagination token from a previous response. Use this to fetch
the next page of results.

props.name: parent
return_details
props.description:
Whether to include additional metadata (timestamps). When true,
response includes created_at and updated_at arrays.

props.name: return_uuids
props.description:
Whether to include namespace UUIDs in the response. Set to true to
receive the namespace_uuids array.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Returns a list of R2 buckets that have been enabled as Apache Iceberg catalogs for the specified account.
methods.description:
Returns a list of R2 buckets that have been enabled as Apache Iceberg catalogs
for the specified account. Each catalog represents an R2 bucket configured to
store Iceberg metadata and data files.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Use this to identify the account.

methods.name: disable
methods.summary: Disable an R2 bucket as a catalog.
methods.description:
Disable an R2 bucket as a catalog. This operation deactivates the catalog but
preserves existing metadata and data files. The catalog can be re-enabled later.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Use this to identify the account.

methods.name: enable
methods.summary: Enable an R2 bucket as an Apache Iceberg catalog.
methods.description:
Enable an R2 bucket as an Apache Iceberg catalog. This operation creates the
necessary catalog infrastructure and activates the bucket for storing Iceberg
metadata and data files.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Use this to identify the account.
